utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, Oren. What time on Saturday can you make it, and I’ll slot you in with the porch setup?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, I’m still in for it on Saturday. I can make the porch setup—just tell me what time to be there.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Can you put me wherever you need me most on Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’m still organizing the Saturday repair drive on the front porch, so I’ll put you where we need you most. I’ll let you know once I’ve got the helper slots sorted.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Rosa — I can help on Sunday at the community center. I’ll spread the word and see if I can bring a couple more helpers too.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s wonderful, Tess — thank you. I’ll count you in for Sunday at the community center, and I appreciate you spreading the word.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Sam. Could you help sort tools and greet people when they arrive?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can sort the tools and greet folks when they arrive. Just point me where you want me to start.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely—I’m happy to help with the repair drive on Saturday. Just let me know what time you need me there and what you’d like me to do.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, Sam. Can you be there at 9 on the front porch and help sort tools and greet people?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, I’m still in for the repair drive this Saturday on the front porch. Just point me to what needs doing, and I’ll help out.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Oren — quick update: the repair drive moved to Sunday at the community center. We’d still love your help, so I’ll point you to the first task when you get there.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Vik. I can use someone to set out the tools and keep things moving on the porch.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect, I’ll put you on tools and keeping things moving for the Saturday repair drive on the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great — what time can you help on Saturday, and I’ll fit you in.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I can help for a couple hours Saturday morning on the front porch, and that should fit the repair drive just fine.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
